questions.question_text:
Consider the following statements about the extension of the Jal Jeevan Mission approved by the Union Cabinet in March 2026:
1. The mission has been extended up to December 2028.
2. Its total outlay has been raised to ₹8.69 lakh crore.
3. Central assistance under the extended mission is ₹2.08 lakh crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: The Cabinet extended the Jal Jeevan Mission to December 2028, shifting its focus from building infrastructure to service delivery. Total outlay rises to ₹8.69 lakh crore with central assistance of ₹3.59 lakh crore, up from ₹2.08 lakh crore at launch in 2019-20. A digital framework, Sujalam Bharat, gives each village a service area ID.

3. It will carry out technical appraisal of all Central infrastructure projects costing ₹1,000 crore or more.

solution.explanation: On 26 December 2025, Israel and Somaliland signed a joint declaration establishing full diplomatic relations, making Israel the first country to formally recognise Somaliland. Somaliland, led by President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Cirro), had declared independence from Somalia in 1991 but had not been recognised by any UN member state. Somalia called the move an attack on its sovereignty, and Egypt also rejected it.
steps: Somaliland: declared independence from Somalia in 1991

questions.question_text:
Consider the following statements about the history of the Bank of Thailand, the central bank of Thailand:
1. Its inauguration ceremonies were held on 10 December 1942, which was Constitution Day.
2. Its predecessor, the Thai National Banking Bureau, started operations in 1940.
3. It began operations in a newly built headquarters of its own on its first working day.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: The Thai National Banking Bureau started operations on 13 May 1940. After the Japanese invasion, the Bank of Thailand Act was issued on 16 April 1942, converting the Bureau into a central bank. Inauguration ceremonies were held on 10 December 1942, Constitution Day, with Prince Viwat as the first Governor. The bank started operations on 11 December 1942 in the former offices of the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation on Siphraya Road, not in a new building of its own.
solution.why_others_wrong: Statement 3 is wrong: the bank began work in the former HSBC offices on Siphraya Road.

fact_checks.claim: Thai National Banking Bureau started operations on 13 May 1940; Act issued 16 April 1942; inauguration ceremonies on 10 December 1942, Constitution Day; Prince Viwat first Governor; operations began 11 December 1942 at the former HSBC offices on Siphraya Road
